messages:
anya: quick sync — trying to get orion-lite-13b-v2 into the catalog and run a perf smoke today. need: weights path, any tokenizer quirks we should know about, and the model_config to pin. target: p99 < 120ms @ bs=1 seq=64, plus throughput for bs=[1,4,8,16] @ seq=512. who can take this?

sam: I can pick it up. weights are at s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/13b-v2/weights.tar (see model-manifest.json inside). tokenizer quirk: there is a nonstandard BOS token (50265) and the HF fast tokenizer will drop it if you pass add_special_tokens=False which caused off-by-one prompt framing in our earlier runs. also we saw emojis sometimes map to <unk> depending on normalize settings.

sam: recommended model_config (paste into catalog entry):
```
model_config:
  max_seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache: true
  dtype: fp16
  quantization: q4_0  # recommended for smoke runs, try q4_1 for follow-up
  tokenizer: hf-tokenizer
  tokenizer_options:
    use_fast: true
    add_special_tokens: true
    normalize_whitespace: true
```

mike: perf command I'll run (copy for reproducibility):
```
python infra/perf/bench.py \n  --model s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/13b-v2 \n  --batches 1,4,8,16 \n  --seq-lens 64,512 \n  --iters 300 \n  --device cuda0 \n  --use-kvcache \n  --warmup 50 \n  --out results/orion-lite-smoke.json
```
Please ensure the node has the qfile kernels deployed (kernel-v2). I'll capture p50/p95/p99, req/s and tokens/s.

infra-bot: started job #job-9876 — logs https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/9876 (perf bench on infra-ml-gpu-07) :rocket:

sam: quick tokenizer note — training used normalize_whitespace=True. if you use the default HF normalizer you can end up with different token counts (esp around emojis and combined punctuation). add `preprocess.normalize_whitespace = true` in the tokenizer config or run the small normalizer step before encode. example repro: run `python tools/tokenizer_repro.py "I love 🤖"` and compare outputs between use_fast True/False.

jules: small ops nudge — pin the `quantization` field in the catalog entry and add a canary rollout (5% traffic) once we promote. also add a trace hook in the Console for p95/p99 for this model route.

sam: initial smoke numbers (job-9876, q4_0):
- bs=1 seq=64: p50 28ms, p95 95ms, p99 128ms (p99 slightly above the 120ms goal)
- bs=4 seq=512: throughput 68 req/s per GPU, tokens/sec ~22k, memory ~24GB used
Notes: KV-cache reduced latency variance on short prompts but prefill time dominates for seq=512. trying q4_1 and a kernel flag change next.

anya: thanks — can you rerun with prefill vs autoregressive (prefill=False) toggles and post p50/p95/p99? also attach the tokenizer repro that showed <unk>. if p99 stays >120ms we'll try lowering the generation max_new_tokens and/or more aggressive batching profiles.

sam: on it. tokenizer repro uploaded -> s3://redwood-logs/orion-lite/tokenizer-emoji-repro.txt. started q4_1 run (#job-9877) with kernel flags: `KERNEL_FORCE_FP16=1 KERNEL_BATCH_ALIGN=64`. ETA ~ 20m.

mike: small measurement note — when reporting seq=512 please include tokens/sec and req/s, and the GPU utilization %. that helps compare kernel-level wins vs batching wins.

sam: will include those. linking interim results when job finishes.

anya: perfect. after the q4_1 run, let's reconvene async — if q4_1 brings p99 <120ms we can proceed with canary, otherwise we drop to q4_0 + tuned batching. :thumbsup:
